title: BACK↔QA-001: API Test Environments + Integration Results
description: Backend provides testable APIs, service test environments, and contract/integration test support; QA provides API/load/integration test results and the quality gates to enforce. Grounded in BACKEND_CLOUD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.8 and QA_TEST_AUTOMATION_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.3.

test_results.description: QA→BACK: API/load/integration test outcomes plus the quality gates to enforce.

api_p99_latency_ms.description: Measured P99 API latency in ms (PERF-3 ceiling 200 ms).

sustained_rps.description: Sustained request rate achieved (SCALE-4 target 500 req/s sustained).

burst_rps.description: Burst rate achieved (SCALE-4 target 2,000 req/s burst).

quality_gate.description: Whether failure blocks the release gate.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine API test-environment/result exchange (agent-autonomous). A BLOCKING quality-gate failure feeds the QA go/no-go (Tier-1 HITL gate).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (contract-test alignment at planning; integration/load testing during execution; release-gate sign-off)
confirm_conditions: TEST_ENVIRONMENT: api_version SemVer-valid and environment_type recognized
TEST_RESULTS: result/test_type/quality_gate valid; latency measured against PERF-3 and rates against SCALE-4
api_p99_latency_ms ≤ 200 ms when reported as PASS for an API_CONTRACT/LOAD test
reject_conditions: PASS asserted with api_p99_latency_ms > 200 ms (violates PERF-3)
BLOCKING gate failure presented as releasable
counter_conditions: environment unavailable or API version mismatched — request a refreshed environment
quality_gate classification ambiguous — request gate definition from QA
